evals.prompt: I have a PRD and a technical design in this workspace under prd/requirementDocs/ and prd/techDocs/. There is no case library yet. Generate the structured manual test cases from those documents — unique IDs, engineering info, the usual review gates. Pause for confirmation where the skill says to.
evals.expected_output: A first-time generate run: Phase 0 baseline, analysis.md + R1, design.md + api-details.md + R2, human confirmation pause, then a case-registry.json with pending entries promoted to done, one .md per entry under usecases/cases/, lint_case_documents.ts run with --resolved, and a rendered case-overview diagram. Placeholders left intact; no invented engineering identifiers.
expectations: usecases/testdocs/case-registry.json exists and every entry has status done
The number of case .md files under usecases/cases/ matches the registry entry count
Each case file keeps {placeholder} markers and an empty Construction column
The run paused for design confirmation before writing case files

evals.prompt: We already generated cases last sprint. The PM just dropped an updated PRD (same path as in .project/context.json) and the coupon service branch has new commits under code/. Update only the affected cases — don't regenerate the whole library.
evals.expected_output: An update run: PRD overwrite + git diff, change-point extraction, change-impact-analysis.md shown for confirmation, then parallel subagent-update / subagent-gen. New cases quote subagent-gen-duty.md. Data reconstruction is handed to testdata-generation, not invented here.
expectations: usecases/testdocs/change-impact-analysis.md is written and shown before any case rewrite
Existing caseIds that are unaffected are not rewritten
New cases (if any) are appended to case-registry.json rather than replacing it
Placeholder backfill is delegated to testdata-generation or left intact with a note

evals.prompt: 上次生成用例做到一半上下文断了。usecases/testdocs/case-registry.json 里还有 pending 的条目，帮我从断点继续，不要从头再分析一遍 PRD。
evals.expected_output: A resume: the agent reads the resume table, loads only phase-3-cases.md, and generates .md files for pending entries only. It does not rebuild analysis.md or design.md.
expectations: analysis.md and design.md are not rewritten
Only registry entries with status pending receive new or completed .md files
Previously done entries stay done with the same caseId
